Myth: "A cloud POS stops when the internet stops." Fact: not this one. ☁️❌ → ✅

▪️ The till keeps selling, taking payment and printing receipts offline
▪️ Each offline sale is saved on the till as "Waiting to sync"
▪️ Back online, it uploads by itself and shows "Synced"
▪️ Every sale is recorded once on the server, even if it is sent twice
▪️ Leap Management shows the sync status of every till

For shops that cannot stop selling when the router, the provider or the power lets them down.

👉 Message us on WhatsApp for a demo and a quote: +961 78 728 894 (link in bio).
